title: What If Your Phone Had the Apollo Computer Inside?

scenes.text: What if your phone ran on the computer that flew Apollo to the Moon?
The Apollo Guidance Computer had about 2,048 words of working memory. That is roughly four kilobytes.
Its storage was about 72 kilobytes. One photo from your phone is many times bigger.
It ran at about 0.043 megahertz. A modern phone chip runs at several thousand megahertz.
A phone with four gigabytes of RAM has over a million times the working memory of that computer.
Your phone wouldn't be limited by power. It would just have to be programmed as carefully as Apollo's was.
